scripts.build: bun run build:gateway && bun run build:agent
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: mkdir -p ../dist && rm -f ../dist/subi-gateway-darwin-arm64 ../dist/seller-agent-darwin-arm64 && bun build --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --compile --outfile ../dist/subi-gateway-darwin-arm64 ./src/cmd/subi-gateway.ts && bun build --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --compile --outfile ../dist/seller-agent-darwin-arm64 ./src/cmd/seller-agent.ts
scripts.build:linux-amd64: mkdir -p ../dist && rm -f ../dist/subi-gateway-linux-amd64 ../dist/seller-agent-linux-amd64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile ../dist/subi-gateway-linux-amd64 ./src/cmd/subi-gateway.ts && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile ../dist/seller-agent-linux-amd64 ./src/cmd/seller-agent.ts
